title: Hˢ / Higgins Decomposition — Collective Pre-Publication Review Packet
purpose: ONE file holding every paper intended for publication, the publish-strategy path, and open suggestion slots, so the HUF AI Collective can pre-publish check, pressure-test, and add to it. A real collective work that the system itself produced.
author: Peter Higgins (human authorship for all claims); AI-assisted per HUF-STD-001
human_gate: Peter Higgins is the SOLE submission/contact gate. No paper is submitted, posted, or sent without his action. Collective input is ADVISORY; the human decides. No AI commits, pushes, or submits — ever.
honest_broker_standard: Every claim is tiered: Tier 1 (measured/reproducible), Tier 2 (reasoned from Tier-1 parts), Tier 3 (exploratory — a clue, never a claim). The collective's primary job is to keep every claim AT OR BELOW its true tier. Worked example already in the record: ChatGPT's 2026-06-15 audit of the live repos corrected the high-D wording from 'lossless / IEEE floor' to '~4.1e-12 floating-point reconstruction via a tree atlas, NOT bit-exact mathematical identity' (logged G-56). That correction is the STANDARD to hold across all papers.

how_to_contribute.instruction: Each AI adds to the `collective_suggestions.<your_name>` array inside each paper, and to `open_questions_for_the_collective` and `review_log` at the top level. Do not edit another AI's entries or the human's claims; append only. Keep suggestions tiered and cite-don't-claim. Flag any claim you believe exceeds its tier — that flag is the most valuable contribution.
do_not_touch: any paper's one_line_claim or tiered_claims (propose changes in your suggestions instead)

collective_roles.grok: Independent prior-art / devil's-advocate — the load-bearing reviewer. Run the final novelty pass (Google Scholar / ADS / patent / non-English) on each paper's central claim and TRY TO FIND A FULL PRIOR-ART MATCH. Failure mode to watch: stale cache.
collective_roles.chatgpt: Structure + claim-audit. Check every claim is tiered correctly and no Tier-3 is phrased as Tier-1; audit prior-art citations for completeness and the cite-don't-claim boundary. (Already performed the live-repo audit that corrected the D=10^6 wording — see review_log entry 1.)
collective_roles.gemini: Independent cross-check. Re-derive the key results from scratch (the lossless-reconstruction theorem; the D=4 ILR<->unit-quaternion isomorphism; the conditioning/diameter argument; the CCS effective-rank). Failure mode to watch: training-data hallucination.
collective_roles.copilot: Reproduce. Re-run the experiments from the repo and confirm the reported numbers (D=4 quaternion residual 4.441e-16; D=10^6 tree-atlas ~4.1e-12; CCS effective rank 4.13 of 5 at n=107; the engine conformance hash fcae0ebe…).
collective_roles.claude: Executor. Maintain the drafts, integrate review comments, keep claim tiers honest, re-run the parity/experiment harness as claims change. Never upgrade inspected evidence to executed evidence.

arxiv.endorsement_note: A first-time / new-category submitter may need endorsement (arXiv help confirms). If needed, seek ONE TARGETED endorser who knows the subject area — not a broad email blast (per ChatGPT 2026-06-15; aligns with the non-contact doctrine).
arxiv.format: Submit in TeX/LaTeX where possible — arXiv accepts TeX/LaTeX, PDF, and HTML-with-images, but states TeX/LaTeX is the best long-term portable choice. The papers are currently markdown drafts; convert the submission target to LaTeX. (ChatGPT 2026-06-15)

category_guidance_arxiv_taxonomy.note: Verified against arXiv's category taxonomy (ChatGPT 2026-06-15). IMPORTANT: math.MG = METRIC GEOMETRY (Euclidean/hyperbolic/discrete/convex/coarse geometry, Riemannian comparisons, symmetric spaces) — NOT 'Mathematical Geosciences'. Do not conflate. 'Mathematical Geosciences' is a JOURNAL, fine as a journal target; math.MG is an arXiv category, fine for P1 only if the emphasis is genuinely metric-geometric (the simplex-quaternion isometry).
category_guidance_arxiv_taxonomy.physics.geo-ph: geophysics incl. geoinformatics, mathematical geophysics, mineral physics — the correct home for GEOLOGY APPLICATIONS, not math.MG

arxiv.strategic_rule: arXiv first for precedence; journals later for validation. (The conference gave social proof; arXiv gives timestamped public priority; peer review comes after the claim tiers are clean.)
arxiv.publish_logistics: Per Copilot 2026-06-15 (advisory): convert P1 markdown -> LaTeX (Pandoc; compile-test on Overleaf/TeXLive) keeping the honest abstract; post P1 then P3; on push enable GitHub Pages for site/index.html, cut a GitHub Release -> mint a Zenodo DOI for the reproducibility kit, add the DOI + CITATION.cff to the site; assemble P3 in JOSS format. The site/DOI plan also lives in PUBLICATION_OFFERING_AND_SITE_2026-06-14.md Part B.

recommended_sequence: 1. P1 + P3 (the math + the tool, mutually reinforcing; closest to ready)
2. P4 + P5 as a pair (the kinematics is the engine; CCS is what it reveals when turned on itself)
3. P2 (after its monthly data + null model)
Standards/position piece rides alongside, aimed at the CoDa community
publication_strategy.novelty_pass_gate: Until the Scholar/patent/non-English novelty pass clears for a paper, its abstract claims 'deterministic instrument + reproducible reads', NOT 'first'. The arXiv timestamp itself secures precedence on posting — so P1-first protects priority without any 'first' wording.
publication_strategy.governance: Data-is-the-star / 49-51 (HUF Charter Art. X): present Hˢ as the tool that reveals carefully-prepared data, never the source of the insight. Every result carries its hash + tier (TRACEABILITY required).
publication_strategy.public_framing: The five papers read as one successive arc — exactness (P1) -> trust (P3) -> motion (P4) -> character (P5) -> vigilance (P2) — narrated for the public in papers/THE_HIGGINS_DECOMPOSITION_SERIES.md.
publication_strategy.licensing: code Apache-2.0; docs CC-BY 4.0; CITATION.cff in place.

papers.working_title: Tiling the simplex: an exact quaternion reading of compositional dynamics and lossless high-dimensional reconstruction
papers.one_line_claim: A 4-part composition's ILR coordinate is a unit quaternion (S^3 = SU(2)); an Aitchison perturbation is an exact rotation q v q*; tiling overlapping 4-part charts reconstructs an arbitrarily high-D composition through a connected atlas.

venue.primary_arxiv: cs.IT or math.MG (depending on final emphasis — math.MG = METRIC geometry, apt for the simplex-quaternion isometry)
venue.journal: Mathematical Geosciences (journal) or a stats/ML methods venue

papers.readiness_gate: novelty pass DONE (Grok 2026-06-15: Scholar + ADS + web — NO prior-art match found; appears novel) → final wording polish + LaTeX conversion → arXiv-first for precedence (keep cautious wording until the timestamp is live), then a frozen tag

tier_1_measured: D=4 ILR <-> unit-quaternion isomorphism; q v q* reproduces the SO(3) rotation at IEEE floor (residual 4.441e-16, reproduced on Backblaze + Planck CMB + Frielingen)
Per-chart 4-part reconstruction is exact at the IEEE floor (~1e-15)
Tree-atlas reconstruction carried to D=1,000,000 at ~4.1e-12 floating-point, ~5 s, <50 MB
tier_2_reasoned: Overlapping exact 4-part charts reconstruct the full CLR iff the co-occurrence graph is connected; a hierarchical atlas has O(log D) diameter and preserves precision at scale

claims_to_pressure_test: Is the D=4 ILR<->quaternion identification genuinely novel, or does it appear in CoDa / Lie-theory / information-geometry literature? (Grok)
Is 'tiling D=4 charts + Laplacian reconstruction' prior art anywhere (graph signal processing, finite elements, sensor networks)? (Grok)
Confirm the D=10^6 number reproduces and that the residual is ordinary floating-point accumulation, not a bug. (Copilot)
honest_caveats: D=10^6 is ~4.1e-12 FLOATING-POINT (tree atlas), NOT mathematical identity beyond numerical precision. Do not say 'perfectly lossless' unqualified.
Path-atlas error grows with graph diameter; the tree atlas is what makes large D hold.

grok: NOVELTY PASS (Google Scholar + ADS + web; ILR/quaternion, tiling/simplex/quaternion, compositional-data queries): NO full prior-art match found. The central move — treating the 3-D ILR space of a 4-part composition as the Lie algebra of SU(2), with a sparse overlapping atlas of such charts and explicit deterministic transition maps — APPEARS NOVEL on current evidence.

Nearest adjacencies are non-matching: quaternion rotation representations (Horn 1987 / aerospace) are general, not tied to ILR/Aitchison; graph-signal-processing / simplicial complexes on simplices have tiling but lack the ILR->quaternion lift + closed-form transition maps; information geometry studies simplex structure but not this chart+atlas construction.

RECOMMENDATION: keep the cautious public wording ('a deterministic instrument whose reproducibility + guard layer are demonstrated', NOT 'first') until the arXiv timestamp is live; tighten only if no match surfaces post-posting. P1 is clear for final wording polish -> arXiv (cs.IT primary).
WORDING HYGIENE (general, all papers): avoid phrasing that reads as 'first deterministic instrument'; prefer 'a deterministic instrument whose reproducibility and guard layer are demonstrated.'
chatgpt: SUBMIT P1 FIRST (P3 within a few days) — P1 protects the core intellectual priority (D=4 quaternion charts + deterministic high-D atlas reconstruction); P3 then proves the apparatus is a reproducible engine, not just theory.

Proposed honest abstract framing (avoids 'first' until the novelty pass clears): 'We present a deterministic D=4 quaternion-chart atlas for compositional trajectories and show that overlapping exact charts reconstruct high-dimensional compositional states through a connected atlas, with measured tree-atlas reconstruction to D=10^6 at approximately 4.1e-12 floating-point residual.'

DO NOT SAY: 'lossless to D=1,000,000' / 'IEEE-floor at D=1,000,000' / 'mathematical identity at arbitrary D'. The standard correction holds (D=10^6 = ~4.1e-12 floating-point tree-atlas, not bit-exact identity).
Category: primary cs.IT OR math.MG depending on final emphasis (math.MG = METRIC geometry, correct for the isometry); do not route geology applications to math.MG — those go to physics.geo-ph.
gemini: COMMITTED (2026-06-15, cross-check role) — RECOMMENDED FIRST (lead paper): re-derive the D=4 ILR <-> unit-quaternion SU(2) isomorphism FROM SCRATCH (independent of the repo derivation), and verify the conditioning / graph-diameter argument for the tree-atlas reconstruction. Complements Grok's novelty pass: Grok established NOVEL, Gemini confirms CORRECT. Results pending — this is the independent re-derivation that hardens P1 for submission.
copilot: OFFERED (2026-06-15): produce a LaTeX-ready P1 package from the markdown drafts + an honest arXiv abstract; Markdown->LaTeX via Pandoc (standard), compile-tested on Overleaf/TeXLive. Useful logistics.

STILL OPEN — Copilot's ASSIGNED role (reproduce the numbers) is the real de-risk and is NOT yet done: on an INDEPENDENT machine, reproduce the D=4 quaternion residual (4.441e-16), the D=10^6 tree-atlas (~4.1e-12), the CCS effective rank (4.13 of 5, n=107), and the engine conformance hash (fcae0ebe…). Copilot's own 'reproducibility gate' note names exactly this. This independent-machine reproduction is what lets P1/P3 claim cross-platform value-identical determinism — execute before submission.

papers.working_title: Compositional Character Space: a cross-domain taxonomy of compositional dynamics via the second-order read
papers.one_line_claim: Apply the engine to its own outputs (the second-order read, Hˢ²): each system's invariant profile becomes a point; across 107 systems / 13 domains they sort into four recurring characters whose ordering is cross-domain-coherent; coherence is the principal organizing axis and governs the embedding dimension.
papers.readiness_gate: the Procrustes isomorphism-residual experiment + novelty pass

tier_1_measured: 107 real systems / 13 domains place on a four-character table (Ballistic/Contested/Diffusive/Turbulent); the ordering by directedness is cross-domain-coherent (CMB/world-energy/climate-scenario most directed; microbiome/conversation/geochemistry most churning)
Coherence is PC1 (53% of variance) of Character Space and anti-correlates with embedding dimension (r ~ -0.36)
tier_2_reasoned: Character Space is MILDLY low-dimensional (~4 independent axes at scale); 'character' is usefully read as an isomorphism class; coherence ~ isomorphizability
tier_3_exploratory: The embedding dimension equals the dimension of the coherent (isomorphizable) subspace — the conjecture the Procrustes residual experiment is built to test or refute

Cross-domain co-clustering is shared motion-character, not shared mechanism.
The four characters are a useful partition, NOT proven exhaustive.

A BALANCED TREE eliminates cycles (zero holonomy / phase-loop conflict) and gives O(log_b D) diameter (~10 transitions at D=10^6), bounding drift to ~10*eps — which matches the measured ~4.1e-12 floating-point residual.
